children: Prabhudas Lilladher's research report on Mold tek Packaging

We raise our FY28/FY29 EPS estimates by 4.3%/2.7%, given 1) healthy near-term outlook, with double-digit volume growth guidance for 2HFY27; 2) improving product mix, driven by a rising volume share of F&F and pharma ( F&F/Pharma volume share at 35.2%/2.9% up from 31.4%/2.5% in Q2FY26; 3) sustained EBITDA/kg guidance of Rs45- 46 despite RM volatility; 4) resilient demand across Pharma and F&F, supported by robust client additions; and 5) foray into high-margin businesses such as semiconductor packaging, supporting sustainable EBITDA/kg levels. MTEP reported an earnings beat, driven by stronger-than-expected realisation growth, with EBITDA/kg improving to Rs45.8 in 2QFY27 (vs. Rs39 in 2QFY26) We believe MTEP’s LT growth drivers remain intact, supported by: 1) increasing business from leading paint and FMCG players, improving utilisation and scale-up of the pharma business; and 2) healthy demand from Cheyyar and Panipat units, along with Hyderabad plant consolidation, driving medium-term capacity utilisation.
We estimate Sales/EPS CAGR of 17.3%/28.8% over FY27-FY29. We assign an 17x PE multiple to Sep’28 EPS, arriving at a TP of Rs345/share ( Rs372 earlier on 19x Sep’28 EPS). Retain Accumulate.
